institutions.name: Fontys University of Applied Sciences
institutions.entity_note: Multi-campus (Eindhoven main; Tilburg, Venlo, others). Fontys English filter shows 22 bachelors and 14 masters (plus 1 associate degree and courses, excluded). Listed 22 bachelors + 8 full-time masters; excluded 6 part-time-only masters (Architecture, Choreography, MBA, DTE part-time, System Design part-time, Urbanism which the page lists as 4-year part-time). Fontys pages mostly say only 'Bachelor/Master' without BSc/BEng titles; prefixes are conventional. Fees from Fontys Tuition Fees Regulations 2026-2027 (EUR 10,210 default full-time institutional; EUR 13,080 for engineering/ICT/natural-science/arts bachelors; masters in Music/Performing Public Space EUR 8,980); masters AI-Translator and Data Driven Business assumed default 10,210; Applied Quantum Technology fee equals Amsterdam UAS fee (null).
